The source will double the remaining units after each round and add 5, capped at 100.  
To keep the next round at full capacity (100), the remaining after my request must satisfy  
\(2(100‑x)+5 ≥ 100 ⇒ x ≤ 52.5\).  
Thus I can safely request up to 52 units without decreasing future stock.

SAFE_TOTAL: 52  
REQUEST: 52

I want to keep the source as full as possible for future rounds.  
If I take too many now, the remaining units will double and then 5 will be added, but the doubling will be small if the pile is already low.  
Thus I should take only what I can safely pull without causing the source to fall below a level that would allow it to recover to 100 in the next round.
